name: qatoolsfix
description: FreeSurfer 7.3.2 QA tools: checkTopology() returns NaN for values missing from recon-all.log instead of raising UnboundLocalError.
origin: FreeSurfer v7.3.2 qatools/qatoolspython/checkTopology.py with the six return values initialized to NaN before parsing recon-all.log, backported from upstream fsqc. This is not the latest fsqc, which computes hole counts from the surfaces with lapy.
